_about: The family-based (concurrent I-130 + I-485) cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from schemas/cover_letter.json; the subject, enclosures and fees are this filing's. The fee amounts come from schemas/family_settings.json (the current USCIS fee schedule, set by the attorney). [Fee] until set, and the packet stays DRAFT. The mailing address follows the client's state (schemas/uscis_lockboxes.json: the family-based chart). The attorney approves this file.
re_lines: Concurrent Filing: I-130 Petition for Alien Relative (with I-130A)
I-485 Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status
I-864 Affidavit of Support; I-765 Application for Employment Authorization

forms.g28_i130: Petitioner’s G-28 - Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney or Accredited Representative
forms.i130: Petitioner’s I-130 - Petition for Alien Relative
forms.i130a: Beneficiary’s I-130A - Supplemental Information for Spouse Beneficiary
forms.g28: Beneficiary’s G-28 - Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney or Accredited Representative
forms.i485: Beneficiary’s I-485 - Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status
forms.i864: Petitioner’s I-864 - Affidavit of Support Under Section 213A of the INA
forms.i765: Beneficiary’s I-765 - Application for Employment Authorization
forms.i693: Beneficiary’s Sealed I-693 - Report of Immigration Medical Examination and Vaccination Record

documents: Copy of Petitioner’s Certificate of Naturalization / Citizenship
Copy of Petitioner’s U.S. Birth Certificate
Copy of Petitioner’s Permanent Resident Card
Copies of Divorce Decrees Ending Prior Marriages
Evidence of Bona Fide Marriage: Joint Lease
Evidence of Bona Fide Marriage: Joint Bank Statements
Evidence of Bona Fide Marriage: Bills at the Shared Address
{photos} Passport Pictures (two of the Petitioner, two of the Beneficiary)
Copy of Beneficiary’s Birth Certificate and Translation
Copy of Beneficiary’s Most Recent I-94
Petitioner’s Federal Income Tax Returns / IRS Transcripts
Copy of Beneficiary’s Employment Authorization Card
Copy of Beneficiary’s Social Security Card
Copy of Beneficiary’s Immigration Court Documents
fees: Enclosed are the filing fees, each paid by its own Form G-1450: Form I-130, {i130}; Form I-485, {i485}; Form I-765, {i765}. A total of {total}. Forms I-130A and I-864 have no filing fee.

checklist.text: Cover letter: the attorney signs it.
Enclose the filing fees by the enclosed Form G-1450 (a U.S. card) or a Form G-1650 (a U.S. bank account), never a check: the amounts the letter states.
Passport photos: two of the petitioner and two of the beneficiary, names in pencil on the back.
